summary: EUR staff reimbursement stuck: FX revaluation + duplicate transaction ID blocking payout
description:
Issue summary:
Several employee expense reimbursements submitted in EUR are failing the downstream payout run. The payments are flagged by the payout engine with a 'duplicate_transaction_id' error after an automatic FX revaluation step. Impact: seven reimbursements (EUR 12,540) remain in 'Pending Payment' state and did not reach the bank file for the March 11 payout.

Impact:
- 7 employees waiting (~EUR 12,540 total).
- Next scheduled payout window is 2026-03-12; if not resolved, manual remediation required.
- Finance Ops is blocked from closing the monthly run.

Environment:
- System: expense-service v3.4.1 -> payout-orchestrator v2.9 -> bank-integration service (SEPA)
- Region: eu-west

Steps to reproduce (finance workflow):
1. Submit expense claim in EUR via corporate card (example EXP-2026-1357).
2. Expense-service applies tax and creates payout item.
3. FX revaluation job (fx-reval-worker v1.2.0) runs during batch at 02:00 UTC and updates payout amount metadata.
4. Payout-orchestrator attempts to create bank file; bank-integration returns 'duplicate_transaction_id' for specific transaction payloads.

Observed behaviour:
- Payout-orchestrator marks items as FAILED with code: duplicate_transaction_id. The duplicate key appears to be derived from a transaction fingerprint that includes the pre-revaluation amount and an internal trace_id. After FX revaluation, the amount changed but the fingerprint generation path did not refresh trace_id consistently, leading to a perceived duplicate when the bank adapter dedup check runs.

Expected behaviour:
- FX revaluation should either: (a) produce a new stable fingerprint/trace_id used by bank adapter, or (b) mark the item for reissuance so bank adapter dedup logic does not treat it as replay.

Initial logs / relevant snippets:
- payout-orchestrator logs (2026-03-11 02:14:05 UTC): ERROR bank-integration: create_payment failed: duplicate_transaction_id (fingerprint=fp_9d3f, trace_id=trc-84b1)
investigation_notes: 03/11 10:30 - FinanceOps (Maya): Collected affected expense IDs and amounts: EXP-2026-1357, EXP-2026-1368, EXP-2026-1372, EXP-2026-1379, EXP-2026-1382, EXP-2026-1390, EXP-2026-1394 (total EUR 12,540).

03/11 13:05 - Infra (Aaron): Reproduced error in staging by forcing fx-reval worker to update amount after payout item creation. Observed fingerprint reuse when trace_id not refreshed after revaluation.

03/11 15:40 - Dev (Sanjay Rao): root cause hypothesis: fingerprint generation is using (user_id + original_amount + merchant_ref) and trace_id is derived from header at creation time only. FX reval updates amount but does not trigger a new trace_id or fingerprint regeneration leading bank adapter to detect a duplicate when downstream payloads carry the same merchant_ref but different amounts.
03/11 17:00 - Ops: Confirmed bank partner (BankX) rejects payloads where their dedup key collides with previously submitted fingerprint values even if amounts differ. BankX dedup window is 48 hours.
comments: FinanceOps - Maya Brooks (2026-03-11 11:02): Added employee names to private note and emailed employees to set expectation of delay. Need engineering confirmation before midnight payroll cutoff.

Aaron Patel - Infra (2026-03-11 13:20): Reproduced in staging; creating ticket for dev to change fingerprint flow. Temporary workaround: manual payout via bank portal after adding suffix to merchant_ref to avoid dedup at bank.

Sanjay Rao - Dev (2026-03-11 15:45): Will propose change: regenerate fingerprint after any programmatic amount update, and include reval_version token in dedup key. Will open PR for payout-orchestrator. ETA for PR: 2026-03-12 EOD.
FinanceOps - Lina Chen (2026-03-11 16:10): Requesting list of affected employees to initiate manual wires. Please confirm manual workaround steps and owner for bank submission.
proposed_workaround: FinanceOps to perform manual wire transfers for affected employees using bank portal. As a mitigation, append a unique suffix to merchant_ref when documenting manual transfer to avoid BankX dedup window. Engineering to toggle fx-reval worker back to pre-payout schedule to avoid mid-run revaluation until fix is deployed.
resolution: Workaround applied: Manual payments initiated for all 7 employees on 2026-03-11 21:30 UTC. Dev merged PR to regenerate fingerprint after amount updates and included reval_version in dedup key. Hotfix deployed to staging 2026-03-12 09:40; schedule to prod deploy 2026-03-13 02:00 UTC. Follow-up: add unit tests and integration test with BankX dedup logic.
